newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Wednesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover rose to 4.0 billion yuan from 2.8 billion on Tuesday.
Traders said the seven-day was the most active contract due to active borrowing by non-bank financial institutions from the short-term financial centres, money brokerages run by the central bank.

"Borrowing was by non-bank financial institutions, with state-owned banks net lenders as usual," one trader said. "The rebound on the (domestic) A share markets today was partly the reason for the heavy trading in the seven-day contract."
Traders expect the rates to rise slightly in the next few days. -- Shanghai newsroom (86-21) 6279-7004
